scope: Exportable dated PDF research brief from the saved watchlist with historical comparisons, source links and explicit missing-data labels.
implementation: Authenticated offline GET PDF endpoint; one SQLite read transaction over membership and latest two snapshots.
Arabic font embedded with license and shipped in the wheel. Shaping and manual word wrapping preserve visible layout.
Watchlist index includes missing snapshots; summaries use saved historical closes and indicators.
Original snapshot IDs, providers, unknown intervals, cache status, market/receipt/fetch/publication clocks and source hashes preserved.
Browser validates authenticated PDF bytes, bounded size and safe server filename; ready-file link reuses the same bytes.
Renderer serialized for shared dynamic font safety. No market fetch or snapshot writes during export.

browser.account: isolated synthetic test journal with saved public market snapshots; no real account or credentials in report

example.snapshot_example: historical public data; not a current live report

limits: Only saved snapshots enter the brief; unsaved refresh-all readings are excluded and the UI explains how to save them.
Freshness, event coverage and unreported candle intervals remain unverified.
Headline selection is title-based and article bodies are not fetched.
PDF text extraction varies by RTL-aware reader; pypdf omitted mixed numeric text while pdfplumber and visual rendering confirmed the original values.
Full infrastructure tests, repository-wide coverage gate and Windows runtime not run. Native terminal unchanged.
